leadership.name: Dr. Ayesha Rahman
leadership.imageAlt: Dr. Ayesha Rahman speaking with colleagues in a school setting
leadership.shortBio: Guides the school's academic direction and works with families and staff to strengthen a connected learning community.
leadership.fullBio: Ayesha works with educators, students and families to sustain a thoughtful, community-focused school environment. Her leadership centers on clear communication, purposeful teaching and creating the conditions for students and staff to do their best work.

leadership.name: Mr. Omar Farooq
leadership.imageAlt: Mr. Omar Farooq in a professional school portrait
leadership.shortBio: Coordinates curriculum planning and supports collaboration among teachers across academic divisions.
leadership.fullBio: Omar works alongside department leads and teachers to coordinate curriculum planning and maintain continuity as students move between stages. He values shared planning, clear learning goals and practical collaboration across the school.

leadership.name: Ms. Sara Ahmed
leadership.imageAlt: Ms. Sara Ahmed in a warm, natural portrait
leadership.shortBio: Helps shape student wellbeing, activities and opportunities for leadership and personal growth.
leadership.fullBio: Sara works with staff and students to support wellbeing and a positive sense of belonging. She helps coordinate activities and leadership opportunities that encourage students to take part, contribute and grow in confidence.

leadership.name: Mr. Daniel Joseph
leadership.imageAlt: Mr. Daniel Joseph in a professional portrait
leadership.shortBio: Supports secondary students through academic progression and preparation for their next steps.
leadership.fullBio: Daniel works with secondary teachers and students to support consistent academic progression and a purposeful transition to higher education or other future pathways. He encourages students to build independence and make thoughtful choices about their learning.

faculty.name: Ms. Hina Malik
faculty.imageAlt: Ms. Hina Malik, English teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Encourages confident communication and a lasting interest in reading and literature.
faculty.fullBio: Hina works with students to develop strong communication skills and a lasting appreciation for reading and literature. Her classroom approach combines discussion, creativity and structured practice to help students express ideas with confidence.

faculty.name: Mr. Ahmed Khan
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Ahmed Khan, mathematics teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Makes mathematical ideas approachable through clear explanations and practical problem-solving.
faculty.fullBio: Ahmed helps students build confidence with mathematical ideas by connecting clear instruction with practice and discussion. He encourages learners to explain their reasoning, try more than one approach and view mistakes as part of problem-solving.

faculty.name: Dr. Sarah Williams
faculty.imageAlt: Dr. Sarah Williams, biology teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Brings living systems into focus through inquiry, observation and practical learning.
faculty.fullBio: Sarah guides students in exploring biology through careful observation, questions and practical activities. She encourages learners to connect scientific ideas to the natural world and to communicate evidence clearly.

faculty.name: Mr. Hamza Ali
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Hamza Ali, computer science teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Introduces computational thinking through practical projects and responsible digital use.
faculty.fullBio: Hamza helps students develop digital confidence by exploring how technology works and how it can be used thoughtfully. Lessons include structured problem-solving, creative projects and discussion of responsible participation online.

faculty.name: Ms. Ayesha Siddiqui
faculty.imageAlt: Ms. Ayesha Siddiqui, visual arts teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Creates room for students to experiment with materials, ideas and personal expression.
faculty.fullBio: Ayesha supports students as they explore visual ideas, materials and creative processes. Her teaching balances guided skill-building with open-ended projects that help young artists make choices and reflect on their work.

faculty.name: Mr. Daniel Joseph
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Daniel Joseph, physics teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Connects physics concepts with demonstrations, problem-solving and everyday observations.
faculty.fullBio: Alongside his school leadership role, Daniel teaches physics to senior students. He uses demonstrations, guided problem-solving and everyday examples to help learners understand how physical principles describe the world around them.

faculty.name: Ms. Fatima Noor
faculty.imageAlt: Ms. Fatima Noor, early years educator, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Builds early learning through purposeful play, warm routines and guided discovery.
faculty.fullBio: Fatima creates welcoming early years experiences where children can explore, communicate and grow in independence. She combines purposeful play with gentle guidance and routines that help each child feel secure and ready to learn.

faculty.name: Mr. Bilal Ahmed
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Bilal Ahmed, physical education teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Encourages movement, teamwork and healthy participation at every stage.
faculty.fullBio: Bilal helps students build confidence through movement, games and team activities. He emphasizes participation, safe practice and respect for teammates while adapting activities to different ages and abilities.

faculty.name: Ms. Maria Fernandes
faculty.imageAlt: Ms. Maria Fernandes, humanities teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Helps students explore how people, places and past events shape the present.
faculty.fullBio: Maria encourages students to examine different perspectives and ask thoughtful questions about communities and the past. Through discussion and source-based activities, learners build context and develop clear, evidence-informed explanations.

faculty.name: Mr. Usman Tariq
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Usman Tariq, chemistry teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Makes chemistry tangible through models, demonstrations and careful laboratory practice.
faculty.fullBio: Usman helps students make sense of chemical processes by moving between models, explanations and practical work. He emphasizes careful observation, safe routines and the value of explaining results with evidence.

faculty.name: Ms. Noor Fatima
faculty.imageAlt: Ms. Noor Fatima, primary school teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Supports foundational learning with structured practice, curiosity and encouragement.
faculty.fullBio: Noor supports primary learners as they build literacy, numeracy and confidence across the curriculum. She balances clear routines with opportunities for questions, collaboration and purposeful independent practice.

faculty.name: Mr. Ryan Thomas
faculty.imageAlt: Mr. Ryan Thomas, music and performing arts teacher, in a natural professional portrait
faculty.shortBio: Welcomes students into music-making and performance through practice and collaboration.
faculty.fullBio: Ryan helps students explore music and performance as ways to listen, create and communicate. Activities are designed to build skills gradually while giving learners opportunities to collaborate and share their work.
